credentials.title: Dropbox authentication
credentials.description: Requires account_info.read and files.metadata.read. Uploading additionally requires files.content.write.

root_path.title: Dropbox destination root
root_path.description: Existing Dropbox folder under which relative record paths are resolved. The destination creates child folders only. Use an empty value for the app root.

max_file_size_mb.title: Maximum decoded file size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum decoded content_base64 size uploaded per record. Files above the upload-session threshold use sequential Dropbox upload sessions.

upload_session_threshold_mb.title: Upload Session Threshold (MB)
upload_session_threshold_mb.description: Decoded files larger than this threshold use sequential Dropbox upload sessions.

upload_chunk_size_mb.title: Upload Session Chunk Size (MB)
upload_chunk_size_mb.description: Decoded byte size of each sequential upload-session chunk.

conflict_policy.title: File conflict policy
conflict_policy.description: overwrite replaces an existing file and is safe for replay. fail stops the sync if the destination path already contains a file.

metadata_policy.title: Client-modified timestamp policy
metadata_policy.description: preserve sends a supplied modified_at value as Dropbox client_modified. ignore lets Dropbox assign its default timestamp.

team_context.title: Dropbox Business context
team_context.description: Optional Dropbox Business member/admin context. Leave as none for personal accounts and ordinary user-linked tokens.

select_user.title: Select member
select_user.description: Dropbox Business member ID, for example dbmid:..., used when mode is user.

select_admin.title: Select admin
select_admin.description: Dropbox Business admin member ID, for example dbmid:..., used when mode is admin.

path_root.title: Dropbox root
path_root.description: Optional Dropbox Path Root. Use default behavior, member home, account/team root, or an explicit namespace ID.

namespace_id.title: Namespace ID
namespace_id.description: Explicit Dropbox namespace/root ID used when mode is namespace_id.
